facebook.text:
Stop treating every client like a new design project.

The switch is the costly part. Different colors, logos, and fonts force you to rebuild the same visual decisions every time another client sends a brief, and generic templates still need a night of brand cleanup. Import each client's identity into its own brand kit once. Pick the right account when content needs creating, and Poaster keeps every deliverable on-brand. More client accounts, no new designer on payroll.

Swipe for the five-slide version. poaster.co, 3 downloads free before you sign up.
